task_description: Implement Python dynamic typing features using minivm's ref system. Enable operations (arithmetic, comparison, truthiness, str, len, iteration, indexing) on Any-typed and union-typed values via runtime type dispatch through host functions using REF_TEST/REF_CAST. When types become statically known through inference, narrowing, or specialization, use existing static paths for maximum performance.

verification.summary: go vet ./... passes, go test ./... passes (all 11 packages), 30+ TestCompileDynamic tests cover all dynamic operations including error paths, dict/set operations, unary operators, and cross-kind comparisons.
